To resolve this, please enable storage permission for your messaging app. Here’s how you can usually do this:

2. Go to “Apps” or “Applications.”
3. Find and select your messaging app from the list.
4. Tap on “Permissions.”
5. Enable the “Storage” permission.

After you’ve enabled storage permission, try sending an MMS message again. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you need further assistance!
